lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade jis mele so milai har aai ||
lines.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har paaiaa sadaa har naam samaai ||4||6||39||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar har naam hai guramukh paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam dhiaaeeai sahaje naam samaai ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar rachai har sach siu rasanaa har gun gaai ||1||
lines.translation: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re jag dukheeaa doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saranaaee sukh lahahi anadin naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache mail na laagaee man niramal har dhiaai ||
lines.translation: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabad pachhaaneeai har a(n)mrit naam samaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan pracha(n)d balaaiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa jaai ||2||
lines.translation: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh maile mal bhare haumai trisanaa vikaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai mail na utarai mar ja(n)mahi hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhaatur baajee palach rahe naa uravaar na paar ||3||
lines.translation: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jap tap sa(n)jamee har kai naam piaar ||
lines.translation: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa dhiaaeeai ek naam karataar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaaeeai sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||4||7||40||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mohi viaapiaa bairaag udaasee na hoi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad na cheenai sadaa dukh har daragahi pat khoi ||
lines.translation: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai guramukh khoeeai naam rate sukh hoi ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur sev mohu parajalai ghar hee maahi udaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh karam kamaavai bigasai har bairaag ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis bhagat kare din raatee haumai maar nicha(n)d ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)gat paaee har paaiaa sahaj ana(n)d ||2||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so saadhoo bairaagee soee hiradai naam vasaae ||
lines.translation: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar laag na taamas moole vichahu aap gavaae ||
lines.translation: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan sataguroo dikhaaliaa har ras peeaa aghaae ||3||
lines.translation: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kinai paaiaa saadhasa(n)gatee poorai bhaag bairaag ||
lines.translation: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh phirahi na jaanahi satagur haumai a(n)dar laag ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad rate har naam ra(n)gaae bin bhai kehee laag ||4||8||41||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee saudaa paaeeai a(n)tar sabh vath hoi ||
lines.translation: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin khin naam samaaleeai guramukh paavai koi ||
lines.translation: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan akhut hai vadabhaag paraapat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man taj ni(n)daa haumai aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.
